name: coalesced_memory_access
tip: Ensure memory accesses are coalesced. Thread block threads should read contiguous memory indices. Use offsets = block_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE) and mask = offsets < n_elements.

name: power_of_two_blocking
tip: Always configure thread block sizes (BLOCK_SIZE) as powers of two (e.g. 128, 256, 512, 1024) to align with hardware warps and cache lines.

name: fused_relu_inplace
tip: For fused activation kernels (like add + relu), perform the activation in-place or inline using tl.where(val > 0, val, 0.0) right before storing the result, preventing extra DRAM read/writes.

name: boundary_masking
tip: Always guard reads and writes using a mask (e.g. mask = offsets < n_elements) to prevent out-of-bound memory segfaults on non-power-of-two shapes.
